        <footnote id="F1">Upon vesting of 1,849 Restricted Stock Units granted to the reporting person on April 30, 2020, the reporting person deferred the receipt of 1,849 shares of Common Stock and received instead 1,849 shares of phantom stock pursuant to the Company's 2008 Deferred Compensation Plan (the &quot;Plan&quot;).
